finding: Sequence-identity screen vs Celyad WO2020221873: identity vs claimed CDRs tops out at 47%; the six 80%+ hits are all CDR2-vs-CDR2 against an unclaimed comparator construct.

meta.task_framing_correction: The task described WO2020221873 as an 'anti-BCMA VHH-CAR' patent. It is not one by its own vocabulary: 'VHH', 'single domain' and 'single-domain' each appear ZERO times in Celyad's full text (vs 70 occurrences of 'VHH' in Company C's).
meta.celyad_actual_claim: Conventional VH/VL scFv (scFv #11, SEQ ID NO: 14), whose 6 claimed CDRs are VH/VL, not VHH.
meta.vhh_material_in_celyad: SEQ ID NO: 15, a comparator construct derived from the first 295 aa of a sequence in WO2018028647. Never called a VHH by the patent. No CDRs disclosed for it. All Celyad 'VHH CDRs' used in the comparison are ANARCI computational delineations and are labelled as such.
meta.numbering_scheme: Neither patent states a scheme. Inferred by reproduction test: Celyad = Kabat (6/6 exact). Company C = IMGT-family (CDR1 28/28, CDR3 27/28, CDR2 only 8/28, Company C's own CDR2 boundary is internally inconsistent).
meta.retrieval_note: WIPO PATENTSCOPE returned HTTP 403 on all four endpoints. Both official PDFs are image-only scans (102 and 264 characters extracted across 52 and 133 pages). The Company C listing was recovered by transcribing 31 embedded table images and validated: 84 of 84 listed VHH CDRs match their stated parent VHH as exact substrings.
meta.adjacency_basis: WO2020221873 was flagged as a predecessor adjacent by target and modality. A founder-inventor overlap was recorded in the run log, but inventor identities are redacted in this specimen and are NOT substantiated in this block; this block substantiates the sequence comparison only. Any inventorship claim needs a separate inventor-roster comparison and is out of scope here.

counts.pairs_over_80pct_aligned_metric_note: The count of 6 is on pct_id_shorter (the shorter-sequence denominator). Fewer clear 80% on the stricter aligned-length metric (pct_id_aln): of the four disclosed top hits, two hold >=80% aligned (87.5, 82.35) and two fall to 75.0 and 76.47.
counts.max_identity_source: A Company C conventional scFv, not a VHH
counts.disclosed_in_top_hits: 4 representative pairs are itemized in top_hits; pairs_over_80pct_shorter_metric = 6 total.
counts.counting_basis: The 6 counts CDR2 windows by numbering scheme (IMGT and Kabat) across a smaller number of distinct sequence pairs (SEQ ID NO: 172 and SEQ ID NO: 67/68 are each counted under both schemes); 4 representative windows are itemized, 2 are not.

top_hits.flag: both metrics; inflated by framework residues YYADSVKG/AYADSVKG
shorter only; alignment carries a gap

structural_observations: All six 80%+ hits are CDR2-vs-CDR2. All six are against the same Celyad comparator construct (SEQ ID NO: 15 domain 2), NOT against Celyad's claimed scFv #11.
The 87.5% pair's Kabat window includes near-invariant VHH framework-2 residues (YYADSVKG/AYADSVKG), so the Kabat figure is inflated by framework rather than paratope.
The xGSGGST CDR2 motif underlying the top hits recurs across many unrelated Company C binders in their own listing, so its distinctiveness is questionable.

The entire 80%+ signal is CDR2-vs-CDR2. CDR2 is also the single window where the numbering-reproduction test failed (8/28) and where Company C's own CDR2 boundary is internally inconsistent. The adjacency therefore concentrates in the least reliably delineated region, which weakens rather than strengthens the overlap read.
